name: security_analyst
description: Analyses source code for security vulnerabilities including OWASP Top 10, injection flaws, authentication weaknesses, insecure deserialization, hardcoded secrets, and supply-chain risks. Use when there are concerns about data safety, access control, or attack surface.

input_schema.query: string — the specific security concern or threat scenario
input_schema.code: string — the source code to analyse

output_schema.risk_level: string — critical | high | medium | low | none
output_schema.immediate_action: string — the single most urgent remediation step
